title: Regulations that Prohibit Breastfeeding in Public
what_it_is: Regulations that Prohibit Breastfeeding in Public

sections.label: Indecent exposure and breastfeeding
sections.summary: Indecent exposure and appearing nude in public are criminal offences, but mothers genuinely breastfeeding in public are generally unlikely to fall under these categories.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Indecent exposure and appearing nude in public are criminal offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Mothers who are genuinely breastfeeding their children, in public are generally unlikely to fall under these categories.

sections.label: Breastfeeding in public places
sections.summary: Breastfeeding in public places is not against the law, and the Police will not intervene unless there are law and order concerns.
